evidence: Carries the Mining label and modifies the BlockTemplateManager and interfaces::Mining to track and report template memory footprint.
rationale: Adds `getMemoryLoad()` to `interfaces::Mining` to address unobserved memory retention when external Stratum v2 clients hold block templates indefinitely. Expanding the mining interface to provide memory observability directly addresses external mining software needs, which is highlighted as a strategic priority in the mining category.
